articles.title: French Fry-Sized Fish Conquer a 50-Foot Waterfall!
articles.summary: Tiny shellear fish, no bigger than a French fry, climb a 50-foot waterfall in Africa using Velcro-like hooks on their fins. It takes them up to 10 hours, and many tumble back down!

articles.title: Solve a Murder on a Submarine Full of Goofballs!
articles.summary: The Mermaid Mask is a hilarious detective game where you solve a murder on a submarine. With silly suspects like a puppet salesman and a dramatic magician, it's one of the best-reviewed games of 2026.

articles.title: Which Song Ruled the Charts the Longest? You'll Never Guess!
articles.summary: Mariah Carey's "All I Want for Christmas Is You" now holds the record for the longest-running No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100, with 22 weeks. It's a holiday hit that keeps coming back!
